findings.title: Missing Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.description: Content Security Policy header is not present. CSP prevents Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Implement a strong Content-Security-Policy header restricting script execution and resource loading.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options header is absent, rendering the application potentially susceptible to Clickjacking framing attacks.
findings.remediation: Configure 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' on HTTP responses.

findings.title: Missing or Invalid X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: Missing 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header allows browsers to MIME-sniff response content types, potentially executing untrusted assets.
findings.remediation: Set 'X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff' header across all responses.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: No Referrer-Policy header specified. Browsers may send full referrer URLs containing sensitive path parameters.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.description: Permissions-Policy header is missing. Controlling browser features (geolocation, camera, microphone) is recommended.
findings.remediation: Define a Permissions-Policy header to restrict access to hardware APIs.

findings.title: Server Technology Information Leakage (X-Powered-By)
findings.description: The server leaks detailed backend technology stack information: 'ASP.NET'.
findings.remediation: Disable or strip X-Powered-By response headers in server configurations.

findings.title: Server Software Version Disclosure
findings.description: The Server header discloses precise software version numbers: 'Microsoft-IIS/8.5'.
findings.remediation: Configure web server to suppress banner version details (e.g., ServerTokens Prod in Apache, server_tokens off in Nginx).

findings.title: Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag (ASPSESSIONIDACCRQCTA)
findings.description: The cookie 'ASPSESSIONIDACCRQCTA' lacks the HttpOnly attribute, allowing client-side scripts to access cookie data via Document.cookie (increasing XSS session hijacking risk).
findings.remediation: Append '; HttpOnly' to the Set-Cookie definition for 'ASPSESSIONIDACCRQCTA'.

findings.title: Cookie Missing SameSite Attribute (ASPSESSIONIDACCRQCTA)
findings.description: The cookie 'ASPSESSIONIDACCRQCTA' does not specify a SameSite attribute, which exposes cross-site requests to CSRF vulnerabilities.
findings.remediation: Append '; SameSite=Lax' or '; SameSite=Strict' to the Set-Cookie header for 'ASPSESSIONIDACCRQCTA'.

findings.title: Cross-Site Tracing (XST) Potential - TRACE/TRACK Enabled
findings.description: Server advertises support for HTTP TRACE/TRACK methods (TRACE). TRACE reflects raw requests back to clients and can leak sensitive headers or credentials.
findings.remediation: Disable HTTP TRACE and TRACK methods in web server configuration.
